channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 31
item.description:
38 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Fixed collision issues with the large rig monument blocker, preventing players from getting stuck near the rig.
  • Restored missing vent cages on the map, ensuring ventilation devices spawn correctly.
  • Added and updated large and small oilrig monuments (S2P), changing resource locations for players.

Base Building & Deployables

  • Improved carvable pumpkin deployment, making pumpkins place reliably for base decoration.
  • Fixed pipe placement bugs: trees no longer spawn inside water pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.

NPC & Animals

  • Fixed a bug where sleepers could not be killed in safezones after a server restart, restoring safezone combat.
  • Fixed frog AI/spawning issues, restoring proper frog behavior.

UI & HUD

  • Adjusted clan tag alignment on player nameplates for clearer visibility.

Weapons & Visuals

  • Fixed glass AK rendering so glass parts no longer appear over water surfaces.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Electrical circuits now update correctly when modified mid‑tick, preventing delayed or missed activations.
  • High‑Quality Map collectables now display their proper names, fixing missing name tags.
  • Beach terrain is now included in water‑pipe topology, allowing pipes to be placed and function across beach areas.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 30
item.description:
12 development commits

Audio & Communication

  • Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

Gameplay & Balance

  • Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 29
item.description:
17 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.

Monuments & World

  • Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.

Siege & Vehicles

  • Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.
